sections.title: Diversity and habitat
sections.text: Hyparrhenia is a genus of about 55 grass species, mainly African. Species are annual or perennial clump-formers and occupy varied habitats; the plate illustrates a member of the genus, not one unique species.

sections.title: Inflorescences
sections.text: Typical inflorescences combine pairs of racemes and spikelets, often arranged in leafy panicles. Spike size and details vary by species.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: Because the genus is diverse, the sources consulted do not support a general statement about edibility or toxicity.
